findings.message: design.md D7 (used by tasks.md 2.4) does not list all the tests that break when PREFERENCES_SCHEMA_VERSION goes from 3 to 4, and gives the wrong fix for one of them. D7 says 'Every test that writes a current-version preferences document adds `viewMode: null`', but: (a) src/adapters/preferencesDocument.test.ts:60-84 expects `"version 4"` (`{ schemaVersion: 4, payload: { ...DEFAULT_PREFERENCES } }`) to load as unreadable; version 4 becomes current and will load, so the fixture must move to version 5. (b) src/adapters/preferencesDocument.zoneLabel.test.ts:59-64 'should read version 4 as unreadable' stops testing a newer version. (c) src/test/features/settings/steps/settings_zone_label_unit.steps.tsx:25 defines `LEGACY_SCHEMA_VERSION = PREFERENCES_SCHEMA_VERSION - 1`, which becomes 3, so 'Existing users get both parts' writes a version 3 document without zoneLabelParts (lines 178-185), which is unreadable. D7 says to add viewMode: null to this file; the needed fix is to pin the legacy version to 2. Name these tests and their fixes in D7 / task 2.4.

design.md D4 says `views.cardsEmptyState` is renamed `views.emptyState` 'in both locale files and every reference' and lists them, but leaves out src/test/features/main_page/steps/main_page_unit.steps.ts:40 (`i18n.t("views.cardsEmptyState")`). Add it to the D4 list (task 4.2).

findings.message: design.md lists the glossary owner 'Location row (docs/glossary/locations.md)' as touched ('Each is extended in place'), but no task edits docs/glossary/locations.md — tasks 1.1/1.2 edit only docs/glossary/views.md and settings.md. .claude/rules/glossary.md review checklist: 'Each entry whose owner or meaning the change touched is updated.' Add a task for the Location row entry (it already says 'Not: a card or a grid row, which are view elements built from it') or drop the claim.

Task 1.1 gives the new **Row header** term the Code owner `LocationRow`, but docs/glossary/locations.md already names `LocationRow` as the Code of **Location row** ('the presented, view-agnostic data … Code: `LocationRow`, `presentLocationRows` … Not: a card or a grid row'). The view component views/shared/LocationRow.tsx renders the whole <li> (sortable wiring, menu, hint, clock change note) — the card / grid row itself, not only its header. The plan gives one name two glossary owners. Name the Row header's real owner (e.g. `ZoneRowContent` plus the menu), or make the entries tell the presenter type from the view component.

Task 1.1 adds `LocationRowLayout.GRID_ROW` to the new Grid row entry but leaves the existing **Card** entry ('how the Cards view shows one location row') without `LocationRowLayout.CARD`, although D4 makes that enum value the code of the Card concept. glossary.md: 'Each entry whose owner or meaning the change touched is updated.'
